title: P-008 live witness gains a CONTENT-level cut leg (K4), gated WI-259-safe atop the key-level K3
body: The live packaged-binary witness (two-instance-hive-from-repo-smoke.sh section 6) already proved the C-001 cut at the KEY-DISTRIBUTION level (K0 join-keys -> K1 control -> K2 revoke -> K3 device-filtered CUT; GREEN per findings-K witness v3, 2026-06-20). That leg is deliberately WI-259-orthogonal (the earlier content F-CTRL/F-CUT probes were reframed to device-filtered epoch-key counts because the scopedApply cross-member guard, WI-259, silently drops A's member-slug content op -> false-RED). But P-008's literal release-gate definition demands the CONTENT-plane consequence (owner writes new content -> assert B can NO LONGER read it / decrypt-fail / ciphertext, while a remaining member reads). Decision: ADD a content-level K4 leg rather than replace the key-level proof. K4a CONTENT CONTROL (pre-revoke): A authors encrypted F-RKCTRL under the current epoch -> B (still a member, holds the CUR-epoch key) must materialize it origin=remote (B can read pre-revoke content) AND this gates K4b. K4b CONTENT CUT (post-revoke): A authors F-RKCUT under the advanced epoch -> the remaining member (owner A) holds it origin=local; the cut-off B (which K3 proved still RECEIVES post-revoke federation yet has no epoch-NEW key for its own device) must NOT materialize F-RKCUT (decrypt gate defers the ciphertext forever) = the C-001 read-cut at the content layer. WI-259-SAFE: K4b only ASSERTED (contributes to WITNESS OVERALL) when K4a established healthy content federation A->B this run; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE and never blocks (the device-filtered key-level K3-CUT governs). When the control passes, a post-revoke READ by B is a C-001 BREACH and correctly fails the witness -> a standing breach detector. Report line K4-CONTENT-CUT=PASS|FAIL|INCONCLUSIVE; probes use RKCUT_PROBE_TRIES default 20 (60s; healthy content federates ~10-12s). Validated: bash -n clean; K4b decision logic proven correct across all four scenarios in isolation. Live full-rig run requires gh tokens (papercupai+aviynw)+Xvfb+a fresh sidecar build and flows into the release gate via live-federation-gate.sh (from-repo leg, WITNESS_PROBE=1). Net: the content-decrypt release proof lands the moment WI-259 content federation is healthy, with zero regression risk to the already-green key-level cut.
